Buoy maintenance notes

Office suite spans carry inline styles that the profile drops.

Right in a right-to-left paragraph is its start.

A div soup line

and a second with a font tag

after an empty line

Handlers, classes, styles and unknown data attributes vanish; the center alignment stays.

A script link keeps its text, [a fragment link](#mooring) and [a relative link](/manual/start) stay.

![Buoy on its mooring](/images/buoy.png)

> A nested quote

> and the outer quote's text

**Bold alias**, *italic alias*, ~~deleted alias~~, <mark data-color="yellow">an unnamed mark</mark>, <mark data-color="yellow">a teal mark</mark> and a color outside the palette.

`bold code` loses its bold; <sub>subscript with </sub><sup>superscript inside</sup> keeps the inner mark.
